sections.title: Economics of Health Care Delivery
sections.description: This course examines how medical care is produced and financed in private and public sectors, economic models of consumer and producer behavior, applications of economic theory to health care. Prerequisite: Course only open to Masters of Science in Heath Policy Research students unless by special request.
